messages:
alex: Heads-up — opened PR to add a service account for the on-prem ingress adapter. Needs security review for scopes + secret handling. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4287 :eyes:

maria: Thanks. Can you paste the IAM policy here? want to check least-privilege quickly.

alex: Sure — I pushed the IAM JSON in the PR description but pasting snippet here for quick view:
```json
{
  "name": "projects/redwood-prod/serviceAccounts/ingress-adapter-sa",
  "roles": ["roles/storage.objectAdmin", "roles/compute.networkAdmin"]
}
```

security-bot: Auto-scan: flagged role roles/compute.networkAdmin as high privilege for service accounts that run in customer-VPC context. Recommend limiting to network viewer + specific compute instance tags. (scan id: scan-2026-03-17-88)

dave: Is that SA used by private deployment only? if it touches onprem VPN or VPC peering, we should avoid broad network admin. Also where are the keys stored?

alex: SA is for the on-prem connector (private deployment). Keys: we currently create a short-lived credential via KMS-backed signer, not long-lived JSON keys. config snippet from helm values:
```yaml
connector:
  serviceAccount: ingress-adapter-sa
  auth:
    signer: kms
    kms_key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/onprem/cryptoKeys/ingress-key
    rotate_interval: 24h
```

kate: OK — good to see KMS usage. Two asks: 1) reduce roles to roles/storage.objectViewer + a constrained custom role for the specific compute ops needed; 2) add an entry in the VPC egress policy doc to ensure no external IP egress. Can you add a release note / security checklist item?

maria: Also request: add an audit log filter for any SA token creation and a vault write path that records which cluster requested it. That makes post-incident lookup easier.

alex: Makes sense. I can replace compute.networkAdmin with a custom role: roles/ingressConnectorOps (will include limited compute and logging perms) and update the helm values + add audit filter. I'll push a patch in ~30m.

security-bot: Quick reminder: PR must include the threat model blurb for on-prem network exposure and a short mitigation table per security review checklist.

dave: Once you push the change ping me. We have a merge window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT — if this needs extra approvals we should aim for the earlier slot.

alex: Will do. Targeting earlier slot. tagging @maria @dave for final review after I push. Thanks! :thumbsup:

maria: Sounds good. I can review after your patch. If you switch to viewer + custom role I'm likely to approve.

alex: Patch pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4287/files — changed roles, added KMS usage note, and added audit filter config. CI running.

dave: Reviewing now — quick LGTM from me on roles change. leaving one small comment about the custom role name.

maria: LGTM once CI passes and the threat model section is added (one paragraph). Approving pending that.

alex: Thanks — adding the paragraph now and will merge after green CI in the early window.

kate: Thanks for moving fast. Please remember to rotate the ingress key per policy after merge.

alex: Yep noted — rotation scheduled in the PR description. Will follow up in #incidents if anything pops.
